ITEM.PTXT: The parking brake mechanism consists of a crank lever that transmits the operating force of the parking brake lever to the actuator assembly, an actuator assembly that pushes out the adjusting bolt by rotation of the crank lever, and a sleeve nut that transmits the force of the adjusting bolt to the piston.

The adjuster mechanism consists of the adjusting bolt and sleeve nut of the actuator assembly, which adjust the screw-in amount according to the protrusion of the piston, and a bearing is provided to allow the sleeve nut to rotate smoothly.
